audit_metadata.audit_title: SoilDepth-AI — Sentinel-2 Independent Dataset Audit & Verification
audit_metadata.auditor: Senior Remote-Sensing Engineer & ML Data Auditor

files.notes: Records exact size (194111 bytes) and exact SHA256 of sentinel2_acquisitions.csv.

independent_recalculations.difference_cause_verified: 71 granules in the STAC catalog belong to ESA Baseline 05.10 encoded with 15-bit integer TIFF tags (BitsPerSample=15). Standard Pillow TIFF decoder raises SyntaxError: unknown pixel mode on 15-bit TIFFs, causing extraction failure. 68 of these 71 dates had duplicate baseline 05.09 granules that were successfully extracted, leaving only 3 unique calendar dates missed (2023-05-02, 2023-10-09, 2023-12-05).

multiresolution_extraction_audit.b02_b03_b04_b08: 10m native resolution grid extracted with dx=10, dy=10
multiresolution_extraction_audit.b11_b12_scl: 20m native resolution grid extracted with dx=20, dy=20

temporal_and_leakage_audit.calendar_assignment: 16:20-16:35 UTC passes correspond to ~10:20-10:35 CST on the exact same calendar date
temporal_and_leakage_audit.unobserved_days_handling: Preserved strictly as NaN, no forward/backfill interpolation
temporal_and_leakage_audit.multimodal_integration_readiness: Ready for feature integration, but must enforce shift(1) lag when predicting day t morning soil moisture to avoid midday temporal leakage

audit_findings_and_warnings.description: 71 STAC catalog items could not be extracted because ESA Baseline 05.10 uses a 15-bit TIFF integer encoding unsupported by Pillow. While 68 of these dates were covered by Baseline 05.09 granules, 3 unique calendar dates (2023-05-02, 2023-10-09, 2023-12-05) were lost.
audit_findings_and_warnings.remedy: Implement a 15-bit unpacking routine or use GDAL/rasterio for complete Baseline 05.10 ingestion.

audit_findings_and_warnings.description: 17 observations categorized as SCL=7 (Unclassified) were included in the clear-sky dataset. Although their individual pixel reflectances are physically plausible, some occurred during high scene-level cloud cover (>50%).
audit_findings_and_warnings.remedy: Consider restricting VALID_LAND_SCL_CODES strictly to {4, 5} (Vegetation and Bare Soil) for conservative agricultural applications, reducing clear observations from 319 to 298.

audit_findings_and_warnings.description: VALID_LAND_SCL_CODES in process_sentinel2.py included code 6 (water), which is conceptually inconsistent with an agricultural upland SCAN station. Zero water pixels were sampled at AAMU-JTG (0 observations affected).
